Vilonia
Suspects arrested after allegedly assaulting police officer & stealing patrol car
2 days ago
Two suspects accused of assaulting a Vilonia police officer and stealing his patrol car Monday morning were located and arrested later that day in White County. According to the White County Sheriff's Office, the Vilonia officer stopped the vehicle for speeding around 5:00 a.m. on Highway 64. The vehicle, which was later found to be stolen from Beebe, fled towards White county before breaking down on Highway 64 in Beebe. After an altercation with the officer, the suspects allegedly got in the patrol car and began to flee with Beebe Police and White County Sheriff's deputies joining the pursuit. After crashing the vehicle in a ditch, the suspects fled on foot and were later located at an address in Beebe where they were taken into custody...
